script_text: Stop! Aquarius, the heavens are flashing red alerts as Uranus skewers your airy spirit and demands your bold response right now. Currently, Mars is hovering in a tense square to Uranus, your ruling planet, stirring impulsive urges in your 7th House of partnerships. Simultaneously, a harmonious trine links Mercury in Virgo to Jupiter in your 10th House, boosting communication and ambition. In love, this Mars‑Uranus square ignites a clash with partners; if you're single, expect bold, unconventional flirtations drawn by Uranus's electrifying aura. Career‑wise, Mercury's trine to Jupiter lights up your 10th House, granting smooth negotiations and unexpected opportunities for advancement. Beware of rash decisions in love today; otherwise, the trine gifts you a natural charm that can open doors to promotions and new partnerships. Follow for tomorrow's reading and let the cosmos guide your journey forward.
